button.label: Check document
button.supertip: Marks possible IPBES house-style issues with [IPBES] comments and opens a summary report. Does not change the text.

button.label: Check voice
button.supertip: Marks prescriptive wording (must, should, need to...) for review. IPBES is policy-relevant, not policy-prescriptive.

button.label: Safe fixes
button.supertip: Applies safe corrections (Platform name, e.g., -ize, dashes, quotes, country names...) with Track Changes on.

button.label: Apply change list
button.supertip: Applies a change table from Copilot or Claude (columns Original and Revised), open in another document, as tracked changes.

button.label: Remove IPBES comments
button.supertip: Deletes only the comments added by the IPBES macros. Other comments are kept.
